claim: Rupee depreciation raised the imported iPhone floor
what_would_support: A larger USD×PKR/USD product at actual availability dates
what_would_weaken: Comparable source dates show no increase
data_quality_limitations: Entry tiers change storage; pre-tax benchmark is not observed Pakistan retail

claim: An imported iPhone should track the exchange rate alone
what_would_support: Constant USD product price and tax/margin regime
what_would_weaken: USD price/configuration or domestic additions change
source_type_needed: Apple launch price + SBP rate + official taxes
data_quality_limitations: No constant-quality adjustment or verified current Pakistan tax schedule

claim: Apples rose exactly from Rs100/kg to Rs300/kg
what_would_support: Same variety, market, unit and season over time
data_quality_limitations: PBS fresh-fruit basket is not apples

claim: Local produce is insulated from oil / FX
what_would_support: Input costs and local price data show no exposure
source_type_needed: PBS CPI/WPI + cost and supply evidence
data_quality_limitations: No apple cost accounts; wholesale and retail baskets differ

claim: Policy explains the whole inflation rise during PTI period
what_would_support: Identified counterfactual isolates policy from simultaneous shocks
what_would_weaken: FX, world prices, COVID and other shocks coincide
data_quality_limitations: Calendar annual values straddle government changes; observational data cannot allocate causal shares

claim: IMF-linked programme policies contributed through specific channels
what_would_weaken: Claimed condition absent or not implemented
source_type_needed: News + IMF staff report/MEFP + official notifications + CPI
data_quality_limitations: Documented commitments differ from implementation and causal estimates

claim: Government fuel/subsidy decisions changed administered prices
what_would_support: Dated official old/new prices and effective date
what_would_weaken: No official change or a different effective date
measurement_period: 28 Feb announcement / 1 Mar 2022 effect; June reversal
data_quality_limitations: Direct fuel-price arithmetic does not measure contribution to all CPI

what_would_support: Dated disruption evidence plus prices and supply measures
what_would_weaken: Changes predate disruption or no exposure
source_type_needed: SBP COVID policy source + commodity data + attributed news
data_quality_limitations: COVID timing and official response documented; apple-specific effect not identified
Assessed aggregate damage is not an apple-price causal coefficient

what_would_support: Dated reports + same oil benchmark + policy evidence + CPI timing
what_would_weaken: No sequential movement or alternative shocks dominate
measurement_period: Feb–Sep 2026; feed through Aug, PDF Sep
data_quality_limitations: Event windows descriptive; no counterfactual; separate months and YoY base effects
